pool4_status: NOT RUN: no external hand ready. KITE ships only collision-primitive fits (assets/collision_primitives/*.json: per-link capsule/box parameters, no kinematic tree, joint axes/limits, meshes or surface templates) for Shadow (dro__shadowhand), Inspire, Ability, Schunk, XHand, MetaHand, EZGripper, Robotiq-3F; no URDF/MJCF or meshes for any of them on this machine, and robot_descriptions/mujoco_menagerie are not installed. psi was trained on wujihand_right, allegro_right, barrett, robotiq_gripper_stick, mano_right (KITE conf/kite.yaml), so Shadow/Inspire/Ability/Schunk/XHand/MetaHand would be absent from both decoder training and psi's exposure list. Needed for one: URDF/MJCF + meshes (e.g. Inspire or Shadow right hand), a 4096-point surface template in KITE's format, a GET robot adapter (coupled/mimic joint mapping, independent coordinates), FK validation against the native model at several configurations, KITE-style synthetic contact generation for 500 evaluation-only goals (2-6 contacts), and a target example bank for cross-body starts.
